references.text: Repeats the instruction that the thank offering must be eaten on the day of sacrifice or the next day, and what remains until the third day must be burned with fire.
Parallel instruction that the meat from the thank offering must be eaten on the same day it is sacrificed, and nothing shall be left until the next morning.
Continuation of the text warning that if anyone eats from the peace offering meat on the third day, the sacrifice will not be accepted.
Similar rule that the sacrifice must be eaten on the same day and nothing shall be left until the morning.
The Passover lamb was to be eaten that night, and what remained until the morning was to be burned with fire—the same principle of not letting sacrificial meat remain.
Instruction that what remains of the consecration meat until the morning must be burned with fire and not eaten.
